data.gender_notes: Gracea is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew and Greek words for grace, charm, and beauty. In the Bible, Grace is a virtue and a quality attributed to God, as well as to people who are beloved of God. It is also the name of several biblical figures, including the mother of Jesus in the apocryphal Gospel of James. The name Gracea carries the meaning “Grace, charm, beauty” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Gracea usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, charm, beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of God's favor and kindness towards us.
data.etymology: Gracea belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grace, charm, beauty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gracea total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: גרייסאה
in_hebrew.meaning: חסד אלוהים, מתנת אלוהים, חן ורצון
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם גרייסאה מקורו במילה העברית 'חסד' שפירושה חן, רצון ואהבה. הוא קשור למושג המתנה מאלוהים, ביטוי לחסד האלוהי. השם משקף את הרעיון של קבלת חסד והטבה מאלוהים, ומהווה ביטוי ליחסי הגומלין בין האדם לאלוהים.

in_greek.name: Γκρέισέα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Γκρέισέα προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'χάρις' που σημαίνει χάρη, εύνοια και αγάπη. Είναι συνδεδεμένο με την έννοια του δώρου από τον Θεό, εκφράζοντας την θεία εύνοια. Το όνομα αντανακλά την ιδέα της λήψης χάριτος και εύνοιας από τον Θεό, συμβολίζοντας την πνευματική σχέση μεταξύ ανθρώπου και Θεού.

in_latin.name: Gracea
in_latin.meaning: Donum Dei, Gratia Dei, Favor Divinus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Gracea originem habet in latino 'donum' et 'gratia', quae significat donum Dei, gratiam Dei. Nomen hoc reflectit ideam accipiendi gratiam et beneficium a Deo, exprimens divinam benevolentiam. Est nomen profundam spiritualitatem et connexionem divinam habens.
